text: My stepdaughter is 9 months old and she's got a temp of 38.3. She's had a snotty nose and been sneezing all day, then at bath time I noticed little red spots on her tummy and back. I panicked and did the glass thing and they DO go pale when I press, every one I tried. She's actually wide awake, babbling away and grabbing at my phone, so she's very much with it. Her mum's on a night shift and I can't get hold of her. I'm terrified I'm missing something, please tell me what to watch for
